maintained_recipes.unity:
.DEFAULT_GOAL := unity.o
.DELETE_ON_ERROR:
SOURCES := src/one.c src/two.c
unity.c: $(SOURCES) Makefile
	@set -eu; { for src in $(SOURCES); do printf '#include "%s"\n' "$$src"; done; } > "$@.tmp"; mv "$@.tmp" "$@"
unity.o: unity.c
	$(CC) -c "$<" -o "$@"
maintained_recipes.recursive:
.PHONY: all lib1 lib2 app
all: app
app: lib1 lib2
lib1 lib2 app:
	+$(MAKE) --no-print-directory -C "$@"
